mode: Loopback HTTP with production handle/service and synthetic in-memory repositories; real uncompressed response bodies; session setup excluded from latency
compression: Per-response local gzip level 9 / Brotli quality 11; sums are individually compressed bodies. HTTP load uses identity encoding; excludes HTTP headers/TLS and browser render time.
limitations: One local Node process/loopback and memory repository; no Azure runtime/storage/compression/capacity acceptance. Cohorts reuse warmed modules and sessions, but each opening transfers full record/assets/selected state without a client cache.
